## a) Random number generation and empirical quantile finding

```{r}
randnums <- rexp(200, rate = 2)
empqtiles <- quantile(randnums, probs = seq(0.05, 0.95, 0.05))
```

## b) Theoretical quantile finding and quantile plots

```{r}
thqtiles = qexp(p = seq(0.05, 0.95, 0.05), rate = 1)
plot(thqtiles, empqtiles)
```

## c) Expected line

```{r}
abline(a = 0, b = 0.5, col = "red", lwd = 2) # Rate of 0.5 since exp rates are 1/2 ratio
```
